slices.intention: classify the complete tagged source inventory and promote only an exhaustive release manifest to materializable

compatibilityRisks: A partial or unknown source inventory is labeled materializable
A customer extension or factory-only path receives the wrong upgrade posture
Expected source hashes drift from the immutable tagged source
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: None; this slice fixes release ownership and copy policy only.

workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Promote an exhaustive immutable source inventory into the single customer release manifest contract before allowing materialization.

slices.rationale: Materialization cannot be safe until every tagged source path has an explicit customer ownership, operation, and upgrade decision.

slices.intention: produce a fail-closed customer-target preview from immutable preflight state without mutating either repository

workPackages.target: WP-4.0 customer target path safety and exact preview
workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Bind source and target preflight fingerprints to an exact path, omission, collision, and byte-size preview; refuse unsafe or ambiguous roots before writes.

slices.rationale: Preview is the default customer operation and must prove target separation, path containment, source cleanliness, hashes, and collision posture without mutation.

slices.intention: stage exact bytes and promote or roll back the customer target without exposing partial writes

workPackages.target: WP-4.0 staged customer materialization and hash-confirmed rollback
workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Write only into a sibling staging directory, verify every byte and preflight fingerprint, then rename into an absent target; recover interrupted staging and remove only journaled files whose hashes still match.

slices.rationale: A separate staged tree and hash-confirmed recovery keep interruption, stale preflight, and write failures from mutating customer work.
